mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Seed Vision</titleLeft><mainText>Zyra's team can see this champion because it stepped on a large seed.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit's has increased Movement Speed for a short duration.

mLocKeys.keySummary: When Nami's Abilities hit allied champions they gain Move Speed for a short duration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: When Nami's abilities hit allied champions, they gain <speed>@FlatMS@ Movement Speed</speed> for @BuffDuration@ seconds.
This unit is stunned for a short period.
This unit has been slowed massively.
This unit's attacks deal bonus magic damage and apply a slow to the target for a short duration.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Empowers an allied champion for a short duration. The ally's basic attacks and spells deal bonus magic damage and slow the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Empowers an allied champion for @BuffDuration@ seconds or @HitCount@ basic attacks. The ally's basic attacks deal <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ bonus magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slow</status> the target by @BaseSlow*100@% for @SlowDuration@ second.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Sends a bubble to a target area, dealing damage and stunning all enemies on impact.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Sends a bubble towards a targeted area, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamageTT@ magic damage</magicDamage> to enemies, and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds

mLocKeys.keySummary: Summons a massive Tidal Wave that knocks up, slows, and damages enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Summons a Tidal Wave from Nami's position.

The Tidal Wave Knocks Up enemies and Slows them by @SlowAmount*100@%, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage. The duration of the Slow increases based on how far the Tidal Wave has traveled, with a minimum duration of @MinSlowDuration@ seconds and a maximum of @MaxSlowDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allies and enemies, healing allies and damaging enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Unleashes a stream of water that bounces back and forth between allies and enemies.

On Ally Hit: Heals @TotalHeal@ health and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion.

On Enemy Hit: Deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage and bounces to a nearby allied champion.

Bounces to each target only once, and hits up to @MaxTargets@ targets. The damage is reduced by @BounceScaling*100@% and the healing is reduced by @HealBounceScaling*100@% each bounce.
